Maison CMT Sartorial Service

Customer Fabric & CMT Tailoring

You supply the exceptional cloth; our master tailors provide the precision architecture, structural canvas, and expert hand-stitching. We specialize in transforming your cherished fabrics, cashmere, wool, or cultural textiles into perfectly fitted bespoke masterpieces across Kigali.

The Cut, Make, Trim (CMT) Protocol

01

Cloth Inspection & Consultation

We thoroughly examine your fabric’s weight, pattern direction, weave structure, and meterage to advise on the ideal garment design and ensure flawless execution.

02

Anatomical Pattern Drafting

Every pattern is hand-drafted specifically for your body architecture and posture at our Kigali atelier (MIC Building / Norvège) — never relying on standard templates.

03

Construction & Precision Fittings

Meticulous hand-assembly, internal canvas shaping, and rigorous fittings guarantee that your fabric is transformed into a flawless, long-lasting garment.

Guidelines For Client-Provided Fabric

  • Meterage & Yardage: Ensure you bring sufficient fabric length for your desired style (e.g., standard requirements for 2-piece suits, trousers, or traditional attire).
  • Fabric Suitability: We verify if your cloth is ideal for structural tailoring (heavy wools, suiting blends) or fluid drapery (silk, linen).
  • Notions & Linings: Discuss whether buttons, inner canvas, and linings are supplied by you or sourced from Mr. Sewing’s luxury inventory.
  • Atelier Drop-off: Bring your fabric directly to our Kigali workspace or schedule a consultation via WhatsApp to begin your project.
